## Landed

- `exports/src/exports/release_changes.py` — `_feed_events` events gain the additive routing fields `compartment`/`entity_type`/`entity_id`/`label`/`jurisdiction`/`source_ids` (the `meta` map computed inside the existing digest pass — one walk, never two; `sig.release-changes-feed/1` shape extended additively).
- `web/src/lib/changes.ts` (new) — the `sig.release-changes*/1` types + fail-closed `validateChangesIndex`/`validateSourceChanges`/`validateChangesFeed`; the SIG-UI-072 two-class separation (`recordEventClass`: `source_withdrawn` removals → `world_changed`, all else → `sig_records`; `sourceChangeClass`: `retired`/`newly_failing` → world, `added`/`lane_changed` → records); `ChangeRow` view model; `changeFeedScopes` (`all` + every emitted place + every emitted source) + `scopeRows` (place feeds descendant-covering).
- `web/src/lib/changes-feeds.ts` (new) — Atom (RFC 4287) + OPML 2.0 emitters: feed `id`/`self`/`alternate`, `updated` = release activation (belief-side stamp), entry ids `urn:sig:change:<pub>:<key>:<change>:<field>`, dates = event world dates; empty scopes emit valid feeds.
- `web/src/lib/changes-fixture.ts` (new) — the committed demo diff (a demonstration second release labelled as such; every class exercised: add/remove/change, `source_withdrawn`, `claim_anchors` noise, all four source kinds).
- `web/src/lib/changes-feed-page.ts` — `PLACE_PAGE_SIZE = 50` (K9 §6.1 page rule).
- `web/src/lib/release-stamp.ts` — `releaseRoot()` exported (the directory the bound release.json sits in).
- `web/src/lib/data.ts` — `getReleaseChanges()`: fixtures → the demo doc; export → `<releaseRoot>/r/<pub>/transparency/changes/{index,sources,changes}.json`; `null` on no bound release or a pre-TX-14 release (typed absence); malformed → throws.
- `web/src/pages/changes/index.astro` (new, T1) — the release pair header (label/pub, world + belief date pairs), "The world changed" + "SIG's records changed" sections bounded at `PAGE_ROW_CAP` with full-diff links into `r/<pub>/transparency/changes/` (rootPath — release namespace), versions diff, disclosures verbatim, subscribe block; baseline + no-bound-release typed absences.
- `web/src/pages/changes/feeds/index.astro` + `changes/feeds/place/page/[n].astro` (new, T1) — the feed directory (all/OPML/source table + paginated place index).
- `web/src/pages/changes/feeds/[...scope].atom.ts` + `changes/feeds.opml.ts` (new, T0 bytes) — the Atom endpoints (minted scopes only; un-minted → 404) + the OPML bundle.
- `web/src/lib/page-types.ts` — `/changes/**` T1 entry (owner P37.40, `sig.release-changes/1`).
- `web/src/lib/nav.ts` — the public "Changes" item.
- `ops/public_routes.toml` — `changes` in `[allowlist].top_level` + `required`.
- `ops/web/nginx.conf` — `location /changes/` scoped types (`application/atom+xml atom`, `text/x-opml opml`) + `max-age=3600`.
- `web/scripts/check-feeds.mjs` — `checkAtom` (RFC 4287 wire shape: feed id/self/alternate, entry id/title/updated/published/category/content, `urn:sig:change:` scheme, parseable dates) + `checkChangesOpml`; the T0 byte ceiling; coverage read off the emitted `.json` twins (slug-history `status:301` stubs never a place page); the no-JS href crawl over `/changes/` + `/changes/feeds/`.
- `web/tests/unit/changes.test.ts` (14) + `web/tests/e2e/changes.spec.ts` (10).
- `tests/exports/test_release_changes.py` — the P37.40 routing-field asserts appended.
- `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-26.md` — CHG-01…14 `pending` + `tests/unit/test_p37_40_copy_batch.py`.
- `web/scripts/root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` — the `changes-feeds.ts` `"/>`-terminator allow-list entry (precedent: watch-feeds.ts's own entry).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — the P37.40 entry.
